title: Chapter 374 Conditions
content:
Chapter 374 Conditions

"Don't force me too much. Do you think you can really kill me? What's more, even if I really fall, I can drag one or two backs. Do you have any idea who will be the scapegoat?"

After snorting a few times, Zhong Yu was also furious.

Since crossing, no matter in the Western world of gods and demons, or the world of Three Kingdoms, or the world of Mingyue in Qin Dynasty, he has always been superior and has never been submissive.

He has always been the only one who begs from others, but fortunately, he is able to say a few soft words now, which is very rare and remarkable.

If it weren't for being in a dangerous situation now, with the curse of longevity on his head, and when he died, it was like a curse, reminding him that time is running out, why would Zhong Yu be like this.

"you……"

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, Susanoo who was facing him froze for a moment, speechless.

Yes, through the confrontation just now, Susanoo confirmed incomparably that the strength of the enemy in front of him was far beyond his imagination, almost reaching the level of igniting a divine fire.

This kind of strength is definitely not something he can handle. If he is really pushed to a desperate situation and fights to the death, he may really be able to pull one or two people back.

He hesitated.

Not far away from him, the divine aura on his body became more intense and extremely active, and the four demigods who could hardly bear to make a move also stopped and stopped flickering.

If the fight really goes on, it is certain that there will be casualties, so who will die?

After thinking about it, they looked at the few people around each other, their eyes turned cold, they snorted coldly, then turned their heads and stopped talking.

Even if these demigods come from the same source, there are contradictions between them.

How could it be possible for them to make wedding dresses for their enemies, they have not yet reached this point.

Whether it is a human or a god, as long as they are wise, they rarely have the awareness to sacrifice for others, especially for their own enemies.

On the contrary, infighting among one's own people emerges endlessly, and they never get tired of it.

Zhong Yu's eyes scanned, and an infinite cold light burst out, in which the meaning of madness and death was not concealed at all, and it was clearly displayed in the eyes of the five demigods in front of him.

Although Zhong Yu's face looked crazy, he was driven to the extreme, ready to do his best, but he was secretly happy in his heart.

The conflicts between these Japanese demigods had been carefully studied and investigated as early as when he attacked Gao Tianyuan, and he knew that each of them could be regarded as life and death enemies, and the conflicts were difficult to mediate.

Perhaps it is possible to unite when facing a catastrophe, but as long as the problem is not serious and their respective lives are not endangered, if they want to unite, then they can only say hehe.

It's like that although it seems that they want to unite now, the distance between them is very far apart. They are secretly on guard, and the power in their hands is only a few percent, leaving a lot of room.

The reason why they do this is that they can't trust their companions, and they are afraid that they will stab themselves while they are weak or attacking.

But now with a few words of provocation, when they are not in danger of dying, the cracks in their hearts reopened, and they remembered their previous hatred.

Gao Tianyuan was destroyed, only some low-level monsters died, and the real high-level capable main force was not damaged at all.

As long as these gods are given some time, they will be able to recover in less than a hundred years.

But they fought each other before, and that was a fight to the death.

Killing each other's bloodlines in the mortal world, trying to cut off the bloodlines, and completely expel each other's legal beliefs in the mortal world.

Even in this high sky plain, they are merciless in attacking each other. In the hundreds of battles in the past, many people have faced the crisis of death.

How could this deep-rooted grudge be resolved in such a short period of time.

So when Zhong Yufu softened, these demigods were moved, especially the latter few demigods who hadn't fought against Zhong Yu.

"Yes, I can let you out, but you must agree to a few conditions."

The four demigods in the back were silent for a while, and Amaterasu, who was the boss, spoke first.

Zhong Yu's face moved slightly, he didn't show any overly excited expression, but he was so happy that he was dying in his heart.

'Finally succeeded, I knew that these demigods had lived for an unknown number of years, and had endless glory and rights to enjoy, how could it be possible to fight myself here. '

But these are all thoughts in my heart, and I haven't expressed them in the slightest.

"What conditions, as long as it is not too embarrassing, I will definitely not have any opinions."

Zhong Yu answered very cautiously, although he really wanted to escape, but it was impossible to agree to all conditions. If you set yourself all kinds of restrictions like slaves, do you really have to do those embarrassing things?

So you have to figure it out before you can answer.

"Don't worry, as a strong man of the same level, I won't humiliate you too much. My conditions are only a few very simple."

With a look in his eyes, Amaterasu looked at Zhong Yu's cautious expression, and said disdainfully.

"I have only three conditions."

"First, after you exit Gaotianyuan, you must never enter again without our permission."

"Second, you must not interfere in the slightest in the competition for the position of the people in the world."

"Third, your territory is based on the position you currently occupy, and you must not expand in the slightest. Except for self-defense and counterattack, you must not provoke any war."

These three conditions are not harsh, and can even be said to be loose.

The first article is just to continue to maintain the peace and majesty of Gao Tianyuan in the past.

The second is just to ensure that the position of the people of the three noble gods will not be tampered with.

As for the third clause, it is even more lenient. Amaterasu knew that it was impossible for Zhong Yu to let the bones that had already been swallowed appear, so he did not ask him to cede the land he had already occupied, but he wanted to maintain the status quo and not let him continue. Just expansion.

These three conditions are very good, very lenient, and quite accommodating.

"Yes, I promise."

Without the slightest hesitation, Zhong Yu agreed to the condition.

It's just some illusory promises, that's a promise, if I don't keep it in the future, what's the matter.

"Okay, since you have no objection, then I will sign this contract."

Looking up at Zhong Yu, Amaterasu's eyes flashed. Seeing such a straightforward attitude, he knew what Zhong Yu had in mind, so he took out follow-up preparations, a contract.

"We swear by the way of heaven. If we violate this oath, the heaven, earth, people and gods will all strike against us."

Amaterasu said in a serious tone, the contract in his hand can attract the witness of the Dao of Heaven, and let the whole world come to serve as a supervisor, and those who violate it will be enemies of this world.

In his opinion, with the insurance of this contract, no matter how unwilling Zhong Yu is in his heart, no matter how plotting he is, he will not dare to violate it.

Where humans can disobey the will of heaven, neither can gods.
